newsitem.title: UK: IPE prompt natural gas may edge up after flex buy.
newsitem.headline: IPE prompt natural gas may edge up after flex buy.

text.p: Prompt IPE natural gas futures may be given a slight psychological boost by a system buy on the flexibility mechanism over the weekend although bids and offers on the physical market were little changed from Friday's bullish close, traders and brokers said on Monday.

At least two separate system buys were heard to have been executed on the flexibility mechanism at roughly 15.0-15.5 pence per therm over the weekend although the quantities involved were not immediately clear and no more details were known.
"That might give May a bullish tone," one broker said. "But the bids and offers (on the physical market) were roughly where we left off on Friday."

Prices were firmer across the board on Friday for those months that were traded on the IPE, although a total of only 105 lots changed hands. October rose to settle at 12.55 pence per therm and widened the contango to 1.95 pence between September and October.
Prices on the physical markets rose too in strong activity.
